title: ‘Hidden’ frame
slide_intent: Teach designers to use a revealing mask selectively. A partial view can invite a reader to look again at people and experiences that often go unseen.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can connect the form of the word AIDS to the purpose of a major campaign or report cover. Rare use can give that treatment particular emphasis.
demonstration: The left column shows the abstract cut-out; the black example at right reveals photographic fragments through its openings with two short blue text blocks.
practical_value: Choose the device for a high-emphasis placement and test which details remain recognizable through its apertures.

content_islands.name: Device and rationale
content_islands.spec: Explain the origin and occasional use in the left column. Show the isolated black mask below the explanation.

content_islands.name: Framed campaign image
content_islands.spec: Set the large field in black. Reveal parts of the photograph through the letter-derived openings and align the separate blue messages to the right.
